Sandbox_WoodShedStorage_Capacity_tooltip:
Storage weight capacity for newly built Wood Sheds (50-2000).
Default 400.
Values above 100 need JB Max Capacity Override AND 'Use JB Max Capacity Override' on.
Without JB (or with that option off) the bay is 100.
Does not resize sheds already placed.
Sandbox_WoodShedStorage_UseJBOverride_to:
On: sheds can use sandbox capacity above 100 if JB Max Capacity Override is loaded (default).
Off: bay is vanilla 100. No JB mod data. Same mod, no extra download.
If JB is not loaded, this acts as off automatically.
